contract:
Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::deleteProductCatalog(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		deletedCatalogs: Set(ProductCatalog) = ProductCatalog.allInstances()->select(catalog: ProductCatalog|catalog.Id = id)
	precondition:
		deletedCatalogs->notEmpty()
	postcondition:
		deletedCatalogs->forAll(deletedCatalog: ProductCatalog|ProductCatalog.allInstances()->excludes(deletedCatalog)) and
		result = true
}
